heo.title: History of Election Outcomes (Parliaments table and Number of Provincial and Territorial Seats tables)
heo.note: The Parliaments table runs from the 1st Parliament (1867) to the 41st (2011). Seats (won/total) gives the House total for each election. The Number of Provincial and Territorial Seats tables give the seats by province for the years listed; the 1882 row (211) differs from the 5th Parliament total (210) on the same page.
